acc.n: Less Accumulated Depreciation on Computer Equipment
Less Accumulated Depreciation on Plant and Machinery

ye.title: Cloudnest licence prepayment
ye.why: Licence paid in March covers Apr 2026 - Feb 2027 too; FY25 policy releases prepayments over the period of benefit in whole months
ye.calc: 96,000.00 / 12 = 8,000.00 a month; licence 16 Mar 2026 - 15 Mar 2027; March 2026 = month 1 (expense 8,000.00); Apr 2026 - Feb 2027 = 11 months x 8,000.00 = 88,000.00 prepaid

ye.title: Grant income recognised for Jan-Mar 2026
ye.desc: YE2 Grant income recognised for Jan-Mar 2026
ye.why: Accrual model: revenue grant recognised over the project months its costs fall in; the rest stays in income in advance
ye.calc: 240,000.00 / 6 project months (Jan-Jun 2026) = 40,000.00 a month (= Schedule 1 budget); Jan, Feb, Mar 2026 = 3 x 40,000.00 = 120,000.00 to income; Apr-Jun 120,000.00 remains deferred in 810

ye.title: Depreciation on laptops bought in March
ye.desc: YE3 Depreciation on laptops bought in March
ye.why: FY25 policy depreciates computer equipment straight line at 33 1/3% from the month of acquisition; the 40 laptops arrived 9 Mar 2026
ye.calc: 47,600.00 x 33 1/3% / 12 = 1,322.22 for March 2026 (47,600.00 / 36 months); not in recurring journal RJ-02, which covers the register at 28 Feb only

ye.title: Corporation tax estimate FY26 (25%)
ye.why: Year-end tax charge is not yet booked; estimate at 25% of profit before tax for the tax adviser to confirm
ye.calc: Profit before tax 2,718,110.27 (revenue 42,232,637.22 less expenses 39,514,526.95, after YE1-YE3) x 25% = 679,527.5675, rounded to 679,528; 830 after: 360,000.00 Dr instalments paid - 679,528.00 = 319,528.00 Cr payable

adj.title: Sponsor monitoring fees
adj.basis: Shareholder (sponsor) fee under the 14 June 2023 monitoring agreement; facility definition adds back sponsor monitoring fees (CFO, prompt 6 Q17).

adj.title: Ferncroft end-of-contract refurbishment charges
adj.basis: One-off end-of-contract batch from the 2021 fleet (CFO); no similar charge in any other FY26 month (324 is a flat £216,000 / £220,800 a month in the ERP history).

adj.title: Pennant FY25 volume rebate credited in FY26
adj.basis: Credit relates to FY25 fuel; it reduces FY26 fuel cost and flatters FY26 EBITDA.

adj.title: Rivermouth grant income
adj.basis: One-off government funding for a six-month pilot.

adj.title: Clean Freight Pilot electric HGV hire
adj.basis: Pilot-specific cost that ends in June 2026.

adj.title: Tarnfield temp-to-perm conversion fees (4 operatives)
adj.basis: Recruitment fee for agency staff moved to Northwind payroll on 9 Mar 2026.
